response.sql: WITH g AS (SELECT BillingState, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM Invoice WHERE BillingState IS NOT NULL GROUP BY BillingState), s AS (SELECT BillingState, cnt, CAST(cnt AS REAL) / SUM(cnt) OVER () AS share, AVG(cnt) OVER () AS avg_cnt FROM g) SELECT SUM(cnt) AS total_invoices, AVG(share) AS avg_share, AVG(cnt - avg_cnt) AS avg_excess FROM s WHERE cnt > avg_cnt

assumptions.assumption: Invoices with NULL BillingState are excluded; empty-string states (if any) are treated as real states since the request only says 'no billing state' and NULL is the standard reading.
The average count per group and total used for shares are computed over all non-null-state groups, before filtering to above-average groups.
